request_text: print <Atomizer Holder V3 element> in black, the plate is clear (21:26:05 UTC); then 'print on the A1 mini' (21:27:35)

source.export_route: GET /api/v10/partstudios/.../gltf with the lab API key at cad.onshape.com; glTF in metres, Z-up, converted to STL in mm with trimesh (merge_vertices, watertight check)
source.change_from_2026_10_06: Sketches 5-6 and Extrudes 5-6: three 10.5 x 3.5 mm magnet slots (one 45 mm deep from a long side at the hook end, two 42 mm deep from the top end), each 1.0 mm from the back face. Old minus new = 4740.75 mm3, exactly the slots.
source.superseded: The 21:20 UTC save had the skins at 0.5 mm (upright slots) and 0.7 mm (cross slot). It was exported at 21:28 and pre-flighted, then replaced by the designer's 21:35:51 change to 1 mm before anything was sliced or sent.

slicer: Bambu Studio 02.08.02.61 (GUI, on the runner's Xvfb display), bundled profiles (configuration update cancelled)
orientation: Stood on the bottom of the hook, as on 2026-10-06 and as it hangs in use: (x, y, z) -> (x, -z, y) from Onshape's frame, back face toward the back of the bed. No supports. Upright slots open at the top (z 28-70 mm); the cross slot is a tunnel at z 5-15.5 mm, roof bridged across 3.5 mm.
skin_check: In the plate G-code, each 1.0 mm skin is two 0.42 mm outer walls with a 0.23 mm gap-fill line between them (layers z 10 and z 40); the cross slot's roof (z 15.8) is Bridge across the 3.5 mm span. See skin_toolpaths.png.
